recommendation.positioning_note: Flat fee beats revenue-share rivals; native cart beats popup rivals. Price at $19 is honest but risks undervaluing at $100k+ GMV stores.
risks: $19 flat may signal low quality to high-GMV merchants used to paying $100-400/mo
No free tier means zero-friction trial requires credit card; add a free tier to reduce churn risk
Revenue-share competitors earn more as stores scale; cartnudge must prove retention at flat price

confidence.notes: 4 established competitors confirmed across multiple independent comparison sources. Pricing scraped from upsell.com, aftersell.com, rebuyengine.com, and zipify.com product page. Zipify OCU pricing found on product page not a dedicated /pricing URL. AfterSell exact per-tier prices are slider-based; $29.99 and $34.99 are the displayed entry points at 200 and 500 orders respectively.
